product_overview: A lightweight personal todo app for creating task items with due dates, tracking completion, editing due dates, and deleting tasks. Tasks are stored locally in the browser and displayed in a simple list sorted by due date.
core_goals: Create tasks with titles and due dates
Edit task due dates after creation
Delete tasks when no longer needed
View tasks in a plain list sorted by soonest due date first
Persist tasks locally in the browser across sessions

features.name: Create Task
features.description: Users can add a new task by entering a title and due date, then submit it to place it in the task list.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in the task title -> Optionally change the due date -> Submit the form -> See the new task appear in the list -> See the form clear and focus return to the task field

features.name: Task Title And Date Validation
features.description: Users are prevented from creating tasks when the title is empty or the due date is invalid, and validation feedback appears inline.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Leave the title empty -> Submit the form -> See a message asking for a task title -> Observe no task is added to the list
Navigate to / -> Enter only whitespace as the title -> Submit the form -> See the same title validation message -> Observe no task is added to the list
Navigate to / -> Clear the due date -> Submit the form -> See a message asking for a valid due date -> Observe focus move to the first invalid field -> Observe no task is added to the list

features.name: Complete And Un-complete Task
features.description: Users can mark tasks complete or return them to active status while keeping completed tasks visible in the list.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Mark a task complete -> See the task title displayed with strikethrough -> See the task remain in the list
Navigate to / -> Mark a completed task incomplete -> See the strikethrough removed -> See the task remain in the list
Navigate to / -> Focus a task checkbox -> Press Space -> See the task completion state toggle

features.name: Edit Due Date
features.description: Users can edit an existing task's due date inline, save changes, or cancel editing without changing the stored value.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the inline date editor for a task -> Change the date value -> Save the change -> See the list re-sort by due date -> See focus return to the edited task row
Navigate to / -> Open the inline date editor for a task -> Change the date value -> Cancel editing -> See the original due date remain unchanged
Navigate to / -> Open the inline date editor for a task -> Clear the date -> Save the change -> See a validation message asking for a valid due date -> See the editor stay open

features.name: Delete Task With Inline Confirmation
features.description: Users can delete a task through an inline confirmation prompt, or cancel to keep the task.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the inline delete confirmation for a task -> Confirm deletion -> See the task removed from the list
Navigate to / -> Open the inline delete confirmation for a task -> Cancel deletion -> See the task remain in the list -> See the delete action restored

features.name: Sorted List View And Empty State
features.description: The task list is shown in plain order by due date, with stable ordering for ties, and an empty-state message appears when there are no tasks.
user_flows: Navigate to / with no saved tasks -> See the empty-state message below the form -> See no task rows in the list
Navigate to / -> Add several tasks with different due dates -> See rows ordered by soonest due date first
Navigate to / -> Add two tasks with the same due date -> See the tasks keep a stable, non-shuffling order

features.name: Local Storage Persistence
features.description: Tasks are saved in the browser's local storage and restored when the app is loaded again in the same browser.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Add tasks -> Reload the page -> See the tasks restored in the list
Navigate to / -> Mark a task complete -> Reload the page -> See the completed state preserved
Navigate to / -> Delete a task -> Reload the page -> See the task stay deleted
Navigate to / -> Corrupt the stored task data in local storage -> Reload the page -> See an empty list

features.name: Storage Limitation Notice
features.description: The app shows a standing notice explaining that data is stored only in the current browser.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Read the notice below the task list -> See the notice present immediately on load

features.name: Keyboard And Screen Reader Accessibility
features.description: Users can operate the app with the keyboard and receive accessible focus, labeling, and validation feedback throughout the task workflow.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Tab through the form controls and task row controls in logical order -> Activate edit, save, cancel, and delete actions using keyboard input -> See the interface respond without losing focus to the page body
Navigate to / -> Trigger a validation error -> Hear or observe the inline alert message -> See focus move to the first invalid field
Navigate to / -> Open the inline date editor -> Press Escape -> See editing cancel and the original value remain unchanged

routes.description: The entire application. A single-page, single-route app with no router and no navigation; the app shell is built imperatively into #app by mountApp.

features.name: Create Task
features.description: Add a task with a title and a due date. The due date field is pre-filled with today. A successful create clears the form and returns focus to the title field.
user_interactions: Fill the "Task" text input with a title
Optionally change the "Due date" date input (defaults to today)
Click the "Add task" button to submit
See the new task appear in the task list
See the form clear and focus return to the "Task" field

features.name: Task Title And Date Validation
features.description: Blocks creation of a task with a blank or whitespace-only title, or a due date that is not a valid ISO calendar date. Messages render inline with role=alert and focus moves to the first failing field.
user_interactions: Submit the form with an empty title and see "Please enter a task title."
Submit the form with a whitespace-only title and see the same message
Clear the due date and submit to see "Please choose a valid due date."
Observe focus land on the first field that failed
Observe no task is added to the list while validation fails

features.name: Complete And Un-complete Task
features.description: A native checkbox per row toggles completion. Completed rows get the task--completed class (strikethrough) and remain visible in the list.
user_interactions: Click the checkbox on a task row to mark it complete
See the task title rendered with strikethrough and the row still listed
Click the same checkbox again to un-complete the task
Toggle the checkbox with the Space key when focused

features.name: Edit Due Date
features.description: "Edit date" swaps the displayed date for an inline date input with Save and Cancel. Saving re-sorts the list and restores focus to the edited row's "Edit date" button. An invalid date is rejected, keeping the editor open and the stored value unchanged.
user_interactions: Click "Edit date" on a task row to open the inline editor
Change the date value in the date input
Click "Save" (or press Enter) to persist the new due date
Observe the list re-sort by due date after saving
Press Escape or click "Cancel" to abandon the edit and keep the old date
Clear the date and Save to see "Please choose a valid due date." with the editor still open

features.name: Delete Task With Inline Confirmation
features.description: "Delete" turns into an inline "Delete this task?" confirm/cancel pair within the row. No native window.confirm dialog is used.
user_interactions: Click "Delete" on a task row to reveal the inline confirmation
Click the confirming "Delete" button to remove the task from the list
Click "Cancel" instead to keep the task and restore the Delete button
Observe focus move to the confirm button when the prompt opens

features.name: Sorted List View And Empty State
features.description: A plain list sorted by due date soonest first, with ties broken by creation time then id for a stable order. With no tasks the list is replaced by an empty-state message.
user_interactions: Load the app with no tasks and see "Nothing to do yet — add your first task above."
Add several tasks with different due dates
Observe rows ordered soonest due date first
Add two tasks sharing a due date and observe a stable, non-shuffling order

features.name: Local Storage Persistence
features.description: Tasks are written to localStorage under the versioned key "i2l-todo:v1" on every mutation and reloaded on page load. Malformed, unparseable or unreadable payloads resolve to an empty list instead of throwing.
user_interactions: Add tasks then reload the page and see them restored
Toggle completion then reload and see the completed state preserved
Delete a task then reload and see it stay deleted
Corrupt the i2l-todo:v1 localStorage value and reload to see an empty list rather than an error

features.name: Storage Limitation Notice
features.description: A standing role=note message below the list explaining that data lives in this browser only. Wording changes when storage is unavailable.
user_interactions: Load the app and read the notice below the task list
Confirm the notice is present from first paint and does not change

features.name: Keyboard And Screen Reader Accessibility
features.description: Every control is reachable and operable by keyboard, with per-task aria-labels naming the task, role=alert validation messages, an aria-live task list, and managed focus across re-renders.
user_interactions: Tab through the form and every task row control in a logical order
Activate Edit date, Save, Cancel and Delete using Enter or Space
Press Escape inside the date editor to cancel
Confirm focus is never lost to the document body after a list re-render

known_limitations.issue: No backend, no accounts and no cross-device sync; all data is per-browser
known_limitations.impact: Tasks are lost when browsing data is cleared or a different browser or device is used

known_limitations.issue: Task titles cannot be edited after creation; only the due date is editable
known_limitations.impact: A typo in a title can only be corrected by deleting the task and re-adding it

known_limitations.issue: Storage write failures (quota exceeded, storage disabled mid-session) are swallowed
known_limitations.impact: TaskStorage.save returns false but no caller checks it, so the user sees no warning that a change was not persisted

known_limitations.issue: Single route with no router or deep links
known_limitations.impact: No navigation to test; there is no URL that addresses an individual task

known_limitations.issue: No filtering, search, categories or recurring tasks
known_limitations.impact: Long lists can only be scanned visually in due-date order
